historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (2.4%) rounded down to the recent revenue run-rate (+0.7% FY2025, +0.6% H1 FY2026) and China nominal growth; EPS CAGR is a margin/finance-cost story on a flat revenue base, not a growth signal
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR 2.4% vs EPS CAGR 10.6% (5yr) diverges >30%: EPS growth came from falling D&A, finance costs and tax on a ~5% revenue CAGR, while a rising payout (61% in FY2025) holds equity growth near 2.5%. Revenue CAGR has also decelerated from 5.2% (5yr) to 3.4% (3yr) to <1% in the last 18 months.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income - lease principal): FY2019 20,170; FY2020 33,458; FY2021 24,511; FY2022 12,892; FY2023 8,526; FY2024 -1,453; FY2025 7,261. The decline is cash capex (56.8bn FY2018 -> 79.4bn FY2023 5G peak -> 67.6bn FY2025) and working-capital leakage, not EBITDA, which has been flat at ~RMB99bn since FY2022. Reported FCF (OCF - cash capex) shows the same shape; the company's own 'free cash flow' (RMB36.0bn FY2025) uses accrual capex and ignores leases, which is why it is so much higher. SBC is immaterial (0.03% of revenue) so it does not distort the comparison.

scenario_narratives.base: The SOE utility case. Mobile and broadband ARPU hold roughly flat under the three-carrier truce, computing power (IDC, Unicom Cloud, AI/model services) grows double-digit and lifts group revenue to ~2% a year, and the H1 FY2026 profit drop proves mostly to be the employee-benefit timing shift management described, so the EBITDA margin returns to the FY2025 25.3% by FY2028. Cash capex falls from 17% of revenue toward 13.5% as the 5G build is over, the capital-payables backlog is settled and the headline stays at the guided ~RMB50bn with >35% in computing. Working capital keeps leaking a little as B2G receivables grow. Owner FCF (post-lease) climbs from ~RMB15bn to ~RMB28bn (6% of revenue) by FY2035; terminal value binds at the 12x cap, not Gordon. The payout ratio keeps rising toward the China Mobile/Telecom 70%+ level, but the model does not need the retained cash to be returned; it needs it to exist.
scenario_narratives.bull: The computing-power re-rating. AI/IDC/cloud revenue compounds fast enough to take group growth to 3-3.5% a year, the mix shift and the headquarters reorganisation (management departments cut ~40%) push the EBITDA margin to 26.5%, cash capex settles at 12.5% of revenue as co-build/co-share with China Telecom and the end of the 5G cycle hold the headline below guidance, and the China Tower lease bill shrinks relative to revenue. Terminal cap 14x and 2.5% growth. This case needs three independent things to go right (monetisation, margin, capex discipline) at a company that has just changed chairman twice, which is why it carries 20%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The value trap. The H1 FY2026 cost step-up is the new SOE wage policy rather than timing, VAT and price competition keep the EBITDA margin at 23%, service revenue is flat for two years and crawls at 1% thereafter, and capex stays at 15% of revenue because the AI-computing build is state-directed and runs ahead of monetisation. Receivables keep absorbing cash (-60% capture) and the tax rate normalises up to 20% as preferential rates roll off. Terminal cap 8x and 1% growth. Governance is the axis: a minority H-shareholder cannot compel the cash on the balance sheet to be returned, and the market has historically priced this name as if it never will be.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A mature, oligopoly, state-owned telecom valued on owner FCF after the full China Tower lease bill and on CASH capex, not the company's accrual 'free cash flow'. The explicit horizon is 10 years so the capex intensity and D&A can mature; the terminal value binds at a 12x cap in the base case. Roughly 40% of the house value is the balance sheet: net cash, bank deposits, treasury securities, the China Tower stake at market and other associates, net of Finance Company related-party deposits and NCI. The market has paid ~0.4x book and ~7x earnings for this name for a decade and has never credited that bridge, so the gap between house value and price is mostly the price of SOE governance and of the cash never being returned. No-re-rate memo: capping the terminal value at the stock's own current multiple (operating EV of roughly RMB25-30bn against RMB99bn EBITDA, i.e. ~0.3x) instead of 12x owner FCF would remove about RMB10-11/share of the base value and leave the bridge plus ten years of flows, which is itself near the current price; the re-rating thesis is therefore worth most of the upside and should be held with that in mind. SBC is immaterial so house and street coincide.
key_risks_to_valuation: The balance-sheet bridge (~RMB117bn, ~HK$4.5/share) is counted at face value; a minority H-shareholder cannot force its return, and part of the cash funds the RMB83bn net current liabilities (supplier and capex payables).

Cash capex has exceeded the accrual headline by RMB5-14bn a year for three years; if construction payables keep being settled or AI-computing capex is state-directed above guidance, the 13.5% long-run capex intensity is too low.
H1 FY2026 EBITDA margin fell 3.6pp YoY; the base case assumes most of the employee-benefit step-up reverses in H2 as management guided, but the guidance is explicitly non-binding.
Receivables grew RMB14.9bn in FY2025 and RMB14.4bn in H1 FY2026 as B2G computing/ICT revenue grows; a -40% working-capital capture may understate the leak if government customers keep paying slowly.
China Tower is held at market via a price ratio; a further fall in 0788.HK or in CNY/HKD moves the bridge directly.

Geopolitical: the ADSs were delisted from the NYSE in 2021 under US sanctions; a widening of restrictions to the H-shares would cut the investor base, not the cash flows, but would widen the discount the model already fails to explain.
FX: all values are RMB converted at CNYHKD 1.1721; the rate is not refreshed by price-only updates.

inputs.share_count_basis: 30,598m ordinary shares, unchanged every period FY2018-H1 FY2026 and equal to the basic = diluted EPS denominator (FY2025 AR basic and diluted EPS both RMB0.68). No options or convertibles at the H-share company; the restricted-share scheme is at the A-share parent (600050.SS) and is treated as a capital contribution. Held FLAT.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash-flow note, 'Expenses for restricted shares of A Share Company granted to the Group's employees' RMB118m (FY2024: RMB247m); no cash equity-award taxes (EquityAwardTaxes 0 every year)
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); H-shares quoted in HKD on HKEX. Model values computed in CNY and converted at CNYHKD=X 1.1721 (Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-10). No parity check is possible: the Shanghai-listed 600050.SS is the A-share PARENT (China United Network Communications Ltd, a different entity that holds ~53% of 0762.HK plus other assets), not a dual listing of these shares. The sibling 0728.HK build used 1.1747 (within 0.2%).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z HKEX regular close (Friday); not an after-hours print
inputs.net_debt_note: Borrowings only, per lease treatment (B): short-term bank loans 1,153 + current portion of long-term loans 627 + long-term loans 5,151 = RMB6,931m at 30 Jun 2026 (interim report p.12-13), less cash and cash equivalents RMB28,572m. Lease liabilities (RMB24,416m) are EXCLUDED because the full lease cash cost is charged inside EBIT. Bank deposits, FVOCI/FVPL financial assets, associates and the Finance Company related-party position are carried in equity_bridge so every excluded income stream has its matching asset.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB. China 10y CGB ~1.8% + China ERP ~6.5% x telecom beta ~0.7 gives a CAPM cost of equity near 6.5%; house uses 9.0%, matching the sibling SOE carrier 0728.HK, to carry state-owned-enterprise governance risk (parent control via the A-share company, cash retained beyond the 61% payout, capex and pricing directed by national policy, two chairman/CEO changes in a year) in the discount rate ONCE. Borrowings are ~2% of capital so WACC ~= cost of equity. The same 9.0% is used in every scenario; operating, capex and margin risk lives in the driver paths, not in per-scenario WACC.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 capital element of lease rentals paid RMB13,384m, AR cash-flow statement line 4802, plus interest on lease liabilities RMB1,118m, AR note 12 line 7534 = RMB14,502m, 3.70% of revenue) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB24,416m at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A for cash tax is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 D&A RMB80,831m less ROU depreciation charge RMB13,363m, AR note 17 line 7867ff = RMB67,468m = 17.2% of revenue). The leases are predominantly China Tower site rentals and buildings, a perpetual operating cost, so (B) is the economically honest treatment. last_fcf deducts the FY2025 lease principal for the same reason: 22,534 reported FCF - 118 SBC - 1,771 interest income - 13,384 lease principal = 7,261.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are 100% consolidated (NCI share of profit is RMB94m on RMB20,910m, 0.4%); the NCI stock of RMB2,611m at 30 Jun 2026 is deducted once in equity_bridge. Charged once.
inputs.capex_basis: Capex is modelled on the CASH basis of the cash-flow statement ('Purchase of property, plant and equipment, right-of-use assets and other assets' RMB67,641m in FY2025 = 17.2% of revenue), NOT the company's accrual 'capital expenditure' headline of RMB54.15bn (13.8%). The gap (FY2023 ~5bn, FY2024 ~14bn, FY2025 ~13.5bn) is the settlement of prior-year construction payables plus purchases of 'other assets' outside the headline. Guided FY2026 accrual capex is ~RMB50bn (12.7%); the base path lets cash capex fall from 15.8% toward 13.5% as the payables unwind completes and the headline stays near guidance. Disposal proceeds (~RMB1.75bn/yr) are ignored, which is conservative.
inputs.working_capital_note: FY2025 cash generated from operations RMB94,295m was RMB9.6bn below EBITDA plus the non-cash reconciling items, driven by accounts receivable +14.9bn (B2G computing-power and ICT business builds receivables: AR 58.9bn FY2024 -> 66.0bn FY2025 -> 80.4bn H1 FY2026) and contract costs +5.3bn, partly offset by payables +7.8bn. FY2023 was a ~6bn inflow, so the 3-year average leak is ~1-2bn/yr. Modelled as negative wc_capture on revenue growth (base -40%); the flat EBITDA margin does not carry the FY2025 leak forward.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2, non-US operating company, plus owner-fcf-adaptations (a) currency, (b) leases, (c) NCI, (d) matching assets, (e) SBC-zero). Fresh build, no prior DCF. FY0 = FY2025 (year to 31 Dec 2025); year 1 = FY2026, for which H1 is reported. SBC is immaterial (0.03% of revenue) so house and street bases coincide and band_position is null. The balance-sheet bridge (net cash + deposits + financial assets + associates - Finance Company net - NCI) is roughly RMB117bn, ~RMB3.8/share (~HK$4.5), i.e. most of the current market capitalisation; the market has paid ~0.4x book and ~7x earnings for this name for years and has never credited that bridge, which is the single biggest reason the house value sits far above the price. See valuation_philosophy for the no-re-rate memo.
inputs.ebitda_definition: Company EBITDA (AR note 2 / interim note 3): profit before finance costs, interest income, share of associates and JVs, other income-net, tax and D&A. FY2025 RMB99,422m = 25.35% of revenue; H1 FY2025 27.1%, H2 FY2025 23.5% (seasonal), H1 FY2026 23.5% (employee benefit expense +19.3% YoY on a timing shift, plus VAT effects). Because other income, interest income and associate profits are OUTSIDE this EBITDA, their source assets sit in equity_bridge.

base.growth_rationale: Service revenue flat-to-low-single-digit (FY2025 +0.5%, H1 FY2026 -0.2%) with computing power (+13% H1 FY2026, >15% of service revenue) offsetting mobile/broadband ARPU pressure; total revenue +1% in FY2026 rising to 2% as the computing-power mix grows, held at 2% = China nominal GDP minus telecom price deflation.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 EBITDA margin 24.4% (RMB ~96.7bn): H1 at 23.5% plus an H2 that recovers the ~RMB5.5bn employee-benefit timing shift management has said will be stable for the full year, less a residual VAT drag; back to 25.0% in FY2027 and 25.3% (FY2025 actual) thereafter. The H1 miss is treated as mostly timing but not fully recovered in-year.
base.capex_rationale: Cash capex 15.8% of revenue in FY2026 (H1 cash capex -6.5% YoY on FY2025's 17.2%), falling to 13.5% by FY2030 as the construction-payables unwind completes and the accrual headline (guided ~RMB50bn, 12.7%) holds; the 0.8pp residual above guidance covers 'other assets' purchases and the AI-computing build (>35% of capex). D&A ex-ROU glides from 17.0% to 14.0% as the asset base shrinks toward the lower capex run-rate.
base.tax_rationale: FY2025 effective 17.8% and cash 18.4% of PBT (statutory 25% less preferential rates on western-region and high-tech subsidiaries); held at 18% on operating EBIT.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30% (matching the sibling SOE carrier 0728.HK) because this is a single-regulator, state-controlled company where capital allocation and pricing follow policy, the H1 FY2026 cost step-up is unresolved until the full-year print, and two chairman/CEO changes inside a year raise strategy-continuity risk; governance is in the 9% WACC once, the operating downside is in the bear weight. Bull cut to 20% because it requires computing-power monetisation, margin expansion and capex discipline to all land together. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
